item: The rollup benchmark route runs without a statement deadline or request budget; its bare COUNT(*) on keyword_mentions is a stated limit, not a defect
summary: GET /api/diagnostics/rollup-benchmark passes the request session straight to run_rollup_benchmark with no statement_deadline and no request budget (checked on main 322bebebc: rollup_benchmark.py has no deadline, progress handler or timeout), so its corpus counts (a bare COUNT(*) on keyword_mentions among them, rollup_benchmark.py:153) and its multi-minute build are unbounded by design: an operator click, generated on demand. A COUNT(1) swap would add a test of a bound nothing sets. A deadline there is a design question, not a one-statement fix; it joins the A-029 hold-bound item.
